items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: I used to play with Buddy PT. Well, we called it Buddy PT's band.

ctx.x: I used to play with Buddy PT. Well, we called it Buddy PT's band. I played with Chris Kelly, well, we called it Chris Kelly's band. You see, the one with the leader, we called that their band.
Were those reading bands, or were they more on the tunk brass band style of them? Just right, the tunk band.
